description: Scaled-up discrete D3PM runs recovered from notebook outputs in commits 649fc7d and 2e0ac83. These were never written to results/, which is why the notebook and the saved JSON reports disagree for similar run names.

provenance.caveat: Recovered from stdout, not from a saved report. Per-metric ratios, validation loss and the metric list were not printed and are therefore unavailable.

metrics_note: ER=337.91 matches the 5-metric scale used in Table 1, so ORCA was present for these runs.

runs.name: low k=8 (scaled up)
runs.note: Best Ratio recorded in this project.

saved_json_counterparts.note: The results/ JSON files with similar names are a DIFFERENT configuration (6 layers, 200 steps, ~8.5 min), not an overwritten version of the above.

headline.interpretation: At the scaled-up configuration the unconditioned baseline improves ~8x over the pilot (327 -> 39.60), so conditioning still helps (-61%) but the absolute gap narrows from ~220 to ~24 Ratio points. Zero validity persists at every scale.
